questions.description: 函数返回转换后字符串。

questions.code_template:
def combine(a, b):
    return a + b, a - b

add_result, sub_result = combine(10, 3)
print(___, sub_result)
questions.solution:
def combine(a, b):
    return a + b, a - b

add_result, sub_result = combine(10, 3)
print(add_result, sub_result)
